ConnectionStrings._comment_DefaultConnection: REQUIRED while Database:Enabled is true: Database connection string

Database._comment_Enabled: false runs the service without a database: no connection string, migrations or readiness check; any query answers 503. The job server and an outbox bus go off with it

Infisical._comment_Enabled: false reads nothing from the store: every value comes from the files and the environment
Infisical._comment: Secrets are read from SharedPath, then ServicePath, and override the rest of configuration. ClientId and ClientSecret (the machine identity) never live in this file: pass Infisical__ClientId and Infisical__ClientSecret as environment variables.
Infisical._comment_ProjectId: REQUIRED outside Local: the Infisical project holding the secrets
Infisical._comment_EnvironmentSlug: REQUIRED outside Local: dev, staging or prod; set it in appsettings.<Environment>.json
Infisical._comment_Defaults: OPTIONAL keys, set only to override the defaults: HostUri (https://app.infisical.com), SharedPath (/), ServicePath (/billing), Optional (true in Local, false elsewhere: a deployed service must not start without its secrets)

InternalApi._comment_ApiKey: System API key for inter-service communication, at least 16 characters. Empty: every call with an API key is refused

HangfireSettings._comment_Enabled: false runs no job server and no dashboard, and drops the settings below from validation
HangfireSettings._comment_DashboardPassword: REQUIRED while Enabled is true: Min 12 chars for Basic Auth validation

ClickHouse._comment_Enabled: false: opening a connection answers 503, the connection string is not required, readiness does not check it
ClickHouse._comment_ConnectionString: REQUIRED while Enabled is true: Host=...;Port=8123;Username=...;Password=...;Database=...; pass it as ClickHouse__ConnectionString

S3._comment_Enabled: false keeps nothing: writes are ignored and reads return empty, so the service runs before it has a bucket
S3._comment_Credentials: AccessKey and SecretKey as S3__AccessKey and S3__SecretKey, never in this file

RabbitMq._comment_Enabled: false registers a no-op bus: publishing and sending do nothing, and a critical line is logged at startup
RabbitMq._comment_Defaults: OPTIONAL keys, set only to override the defaults: Host (localhost), UserName and Password (guest; pass real credentials as RabbitMq__UserName and RabbitMq__Password, never in this file), PurgeOnStartup (false), RetryLimit (3), RetryInitialIntervalSeconds (1), RetryIntervalIncrementSeconds (2)

Cors._comment_AllowedOrigins: REQUIRED for production: Array of allowed origins for CORS
Cors._comment_AllowedMethods: OPTIONAL: Array of allowed HTTP methods (default: GET, POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS)
Cors._comment_AllowCredentials: OPTIONAL: Whether to allow credentials (cookies, auth headers)
Cors._comment_PreflightMaxAge: OPTIONAL: Preflight cache duration in seconds (default: 3600)
Cors._comment_AllowedHeaders: OPTIONAL: Array of allowed headers (if empty, allows any)
Cors._comment_ExposedHeaders: OPTIONAL: Array of exposed headers (if empty, allows any)
